title: Noise-aware quantum ensembles and learned feature-map compression (taqcc)

creators.name: Okekeogbu, Chibuike C.
creators.affiliation: North Carolina Agricultural and Technical State University

description:
Code, cached circuits and result files behind every table and figure of the article "Noise-Aware Fusion of Quantum Kernel Ensembles for IoT Intrusion Detection" by C. C. Okekeogbu, S. A. Mostafa and A. Patooghy (SN Computer Science, under revision; extended from the DCAS 2026 paper, doi 10.1109/DCAS69364.2026.11544356). scripts/verify_paper_numbers.py rechecks all 832 published values against the result files. Tag v1.1-final differs from v1.1-revision only in documentation and two table captions; no result file changed.

Funding: the work is supported in part by the National Science Foundation through grant No. 2619039.
